data.title: 爱夏·晨光中的账目核对
data.action: 左手压住账册，右手用羽毛笔圈出一项数字
data.description: 晨光从书桌左侧照入。爱夏坐在桌后，左手压住摊开的账册，右手的羽毛笔停在刚圈出的数字上，眉梢微挑。深褐连衣裙与白色围裙保持整齐；前景的收据束与后方的分类书架交代宅邸事务，焦点落在脸、笔尖和账页之间。
data.promptProse: Adult Aisha pauses at the oak desk with her right-hand quill touching a circled ledger entry and her left palm keeping the page flat, eyebrow raised at a discrepancy. Covered dark-brown maid dress, white frilled apron, ascot and plain headdress retain the outfit. The waist-up view places receipts at the near corner and storage shelves behind. Left-window morning light illuminates face, quill and paper, casting the receipt stack's short shadow toward the shaded shelves.
